Lily likes rainy days best. Lily usually has dumplings for breakfast. Lily and Max had great fun there. His calligraphy fills the shop signs.
Lily bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday. Max is interested in swimming. The photo club is one of the best places in the city. The quarter enjoys a small renaissance.
Lily hopes to visit Paris one day. Life is full of small surprises. Both of them like dumplings and milk. Also, the gallery opens at ten on Sundays.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the photo club by bike. There are always many people at the story-writing desk. Lily learned a lot about math.
